verdict.rationale: Docs reference error status/actions (bugsnag-docs-3) and automatic assignment rules (bugsnag-docs-2), implying triage states like assign/resolve exist, but there's no explicit documentation of ignore/snooze actions or of automatic reopening of a resolved issue upon regression. missing for 10: explicit docs on ignore/snooze workflow, explicit auto-reopen-on-regression behavior, independent/hands-on confirmation of these triage actions.
